scope: Primary-source investigation, labelled nonrepresentative access probes, and a complete OpenAIRE census of frozen Today and Recent populations.
score_policy: Unknown scores and coverage remain null. No numeric total is assigned without supporting empirical evidence.

providers.name: Official arXiv
providers.metric_definition_summary: No public individual-paper usage endpoint established.

retention.reason: Provider terms require contact before regular storage and restrict third-party redistribution; no exception established.

providers.name: Mendeley
providers.metric_definition_summary: Current library saves and group membership.

providers.name: OpenAIRE UsageCounts
providers.metric_definition_summary: Participating-repository usage; Graph metric window not established.
limitations: No available usage values in this cohort; unavailable values are not zero.
No longitudinal observations or proved measurement window.
Today metadata matches are dominated by older replacements.
No general claim about future cohorts or other providers is supported.

providers.name: alphaXiv
providers.metric_definition_summary: Third-party platform activity; raw complete-population contract unvalidated.

providers.name: ArcXiv
providers.metric_definition_summary: Public API probe matched metadata but returned no raw readership field.

providers.name: Emergent Mind
providers.metric_definition_summary: Separate social and citation counters; not reads.

providers.name: Altmetric
providers.metric_definition_summary: Attention data under granted key/license scope.

providers.name: Crossref Event Data
providers.metric_definition_summary: Event Data retired April 23, 2026; historical archive only.

providers.name: MathOverflow
providers.metric_definition_summary: Observed scholarly discussion, with bounded search semantics.

providers.name: Bluesky
providers.metric_definition_summary: Observed social mentions; completeness and aliases require validation.

providers.name: Zenodo / institutional repositories
providers.metric_definition_summary: Repository record/file usage; deposited-copy matching required.

providers.name: Hugging Face Papers
providers.metric_definition_summary: Community platform votes; not mathematics population completeness.

providers.name: Scholar Feed
providers.metric_definition_summary: Recommendation/impact composite unsuitable as observed readership.

providers.name: papers.cool and keyword-ranking projects
providers.metric_definition_summary: Discovery interfaces; no verified readership API.

empirical_evidence.interpretation: No available view/download values. Missing fields are not measured zeros; query-match rates are cohort-specific and do not establish indexing latency.
